results.goal: Build a usable persistent task list, download and run its actual source, then revise its heading while preserving the accepted parent and add/remove/reload behavior.
results.prerequisite: Real local model and existing software build dependencies; no scripted inference.

assertions.name: task-list-parent exact request, state and actual persisted activity are inspectable in Software work.
Checked source ZIP has visible prerequisites and real build/start commands; instructions do not claim to launch an app.
task-list-parent downloaded source matches the verified artifact bytes and SHA-256.
Actual produced bundle and independently extracted/downloaded source build both add, remove individual tasks and preserve the remaining list after reload.
task-list-revision exact request, state and actual persisted activity are inspectable in Software work.
task-list-revision downloaded source matches the verified artifact bytes and SHA-256.
Same owned origin and retained browser context: parent list survives actual server replacement with My Week; add/remove/reload still work without cross-port data transfer.
task-list-parent-after-revision downloaded source matches the verified artifact bytes and SHA-256.
Explicit linked revision has My Week with original behavior; parent record and downloaded artifact remain identical across revision and reload without replay.

limitations: Installed Chrome with desktop/touch emulation; no physical handset or native voice quality claim.
No test-supplied inference, API seeding, model download or external provisioning.

runtime.speech: Streaming Pocket TTS with local LavaSR enhancement

persistedSoftwareTasks.goal: Build a task-list application with heading My Tasks, a text input labelled New task, an Add button, and a Remove button for each task. Add task text to the list, remove individual tasks, and persist remaining tasks after a page reload. Include browser checks and give me the source ZIP.

requirements.description: Show exactly "My Tasks" with labelled input "New task", "Add" and per-item "Remove". Add nonblank text, remove only its selected item (including duplicates), and persist the remaining collection after reload.
